archetypes.name: dyn-step5-logs
archetypes.rationale: Step 5 terminal paths and run-log artifacts are the main regression surface.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 5 terminal success paths and flush wrapper behavior. Check that complete and cap-hit exits flush code-review batches before the terminal envelope, that flush exceptions cannot convert success into a stall, and that final-report Code review text comes only from the code-review tally. Pay special attention to the new tests' coverage of call arguments and warning behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
